user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygons covering State College in a format accepted by zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering State College. Return a GeoPackage candidate. Runtime QC must verify spatial coverage, polygon geometry validity, CRS presence, and suitability as census tract zones.

workflow_steps.title: Clip 30-meter elevation raster to State College
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the qualifying 30-meter elevation raster to the supplied State College boundary before zonal aggregation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip input_2 using input_3 as the polygon mask. Preserve the 30-meter raster resolution and CRS. Do not substitute input_1 for the final elevation source.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation of the qualifying 30-meter raster within each State College census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate mean zonal statistics using clipped_30m_elevation as the raster and census_tracts as polygon zones. Preserve the tract identifier and other zone attributes in the CSV output. Ground the zone identifier and output field names from runtime schema evidence; do not guess field names. input_1 is an optional lower-resolution reference and must not be selected for the final statistic.
